title: Film program social sequence

location.series: COLLINS / San Francisco Symphony case study
location.extent: Whole published artwork or representative frame of complete local clip

slide_intent: Give different films distinct visual entries because a program family must accommodate contrasting stories.
strategic_value: A common social frame and variable lettering can connect Get Out, Vertigo and Up without making their imagery identical.
demonstration: A social sequence moves from black-and-white Get Out lettering and imagery to purple Vertigo geometry and a bright Up balloon image.
practical_value: Adapt title treatment to each film while retaining the campaign’s frame and typographic behavior.

content_islands.name: Film cards
content_islands.spec: Preserve the three successive title/image treatments within the social frame.

content_islands.name: Transitions
content_islands.spec: Keep the sliding changes and animated lettering that connect the cards.
